ranked.headline: Structure-anchored representation learning for spatial and single-cell omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address alignment, batch correction, deconvolution, and quality control across spatial and single-cell omics modalities and scales.

ranked.headline: Mechanical models couple cell confinement, cytoplasmic flow and forces to morphology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair cell-scale mechanical models with confinement, flow and Bayesian force-inference tools to predict and infer cell behavior.

ranked.headline: Open software spans single-cell DNA, integration site safety, and leukemia modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend analysis tooling into single-cell DNA subclonality, lentiviral integration safety, and T-ALL transcriptome classification.

ranked.headline: Software tools bridging omics platform outputs and downstream analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Platform- and engine-specific omics outputs require automated conversion, validation, and annotation before downstream analysis can proceed.

ranked.headline: Genome and metagenome mining links microbial sequence content to function and ecology
ranked.summary: Expanding genome, metagenome, and protein-family collections now allow specific trait classes to be assigned from broad environmental and host sampling.

ranked.headline: Transformer and geometric deep learning for molecular and protein property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs large pretrained SELFIES transformers and geometric graphs with biophysical priors for property and stability prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational tools prioritize tumor neoantigens from sequencing and immunopeptidomics
ranked.summary: Sequencing-scale data now enable in silico prediction of MHC-presented and immunogenic neoantigens, including fusion-derived targets in pediatric cancer.

ranked.headline: Pretrained protein models adapted for stability, design, and conformational sampling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair learned sequence and structure models with physical constraints and experimental stability data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking docking, FlexS, and deep learning methods for coronavirus Mpro binding
ranked.summary: Side-by-side evaluation of binding sampling and scoring strategies now spans MD, docking, and deep learning pose and affinity methods on shared benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Experimental restraints and force fields refine biomolecular conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple chemical probing, NMR restraints and MD benchmarks to test whether molecular mechanics ensembles match experimental structural data.

ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in curated biomedical databases and literature for discovery tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published pipeline benchmark and build multi-agent LLM systems over curated protein, spatial, and literature resources.

ranked.headline: Phage and selection models link bacterial population dynamics to genome evolution
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model selection on accessory genomes and phage-bacteria dynamics, bearing on vaccine surveillance and phage therapy design.

ranked.headline: Nanopore direct RNA workflows refine modification site calling accuracy
ranked.summary: Nanopore direct RNA modification calling is being tuned for precision through AI models and systematic parameter optimisation.

ranked.headline: Foundation and deep models advance cell phenotyping and subtyping in biomedical images
ranked.summary: Foundation-model and weakly supervised methods are being packaged with usable tools for H&E whole-slide and multiplexed immunofluorescence image analysis.

ranked.headline: Graph models integrate multi-omics and interaction networks to predict molecular links
ranked.summary: Graph and deep learning models now combine multi-omics and interaction networks, with new benchmarks testing cancer biomarker discovery methods.

ranked.headline: New tools for scalable genome-scale sequence alignment, assembly and annotation
ranked.summary: Genome collections now span hundreds of thousands to millions of assemblies, demanding memory-efficient alignment and automated comparative pipelines.

ranked.headline: Individualized brain network models and multivariate comparison of subject parcellations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair subject-specific network analysis with multivariate comparison of individual brain network configurations.

ranked.headline: Designed minibinders reach nanomolar affinity for viral receptor-binding domains
ranked.summary: Computational design and epitope scoring now gate experimental characterisation of binders against viral receptor-binding domains.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict bacterial resistance, protein interactions and function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair pretrained genomic and protein language models with attention architectures for bacterial genotype-phenotype and interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Scalable methods for heritability, ancestry inference, and multi-omics outcome modelling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers offer faster, reference-population-aware tools for heritability, ancestry inference, and outcome modelling.

ranked.headline: Deep learning designs tissue-specific mouse enhancers that function in vivo
ranked.summary: Generative and deep learning models now design functional cell-type enhancers, while single-cell tools resolve CRISPR edits in vivo.

ranked.headline: Biological sequence language models span protein fitness, mRNA design and DNA function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend large pretrained sequence models to protein families, mRNA coding sequences and cross-kingdom DNA.

ranked.headline: Network structure and interactions shape epidemic, cooperative, and ecosystem outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications model lockdowns, tag-based cooperation, trade contagion, and ecosystem interactions on structured networks.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold model quality assessed via residue neighborhoods and pLDDT fragmentation
ranked.summary: Proteome-scale AlphaFold-DB models need residue-level descriptors to separate folded, disordered, and implausible predictions.

ranked.headline: Open tools refine primer design and viral enrichment for targeted sequencing
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints release open-source tools for primer design, reference database construction, and viral read enrichment in sequencing workflows.

ranked.headline: Inferring dynamics and periodic phases from static single-cell snapshots
ranked.summary: Static single-cell and spatial snapshots increasingly carry dynamic and periodic information, so modeling assumptions now determine what can be inferred.

ranked.headline: Noise shapes timing precision, bistability and adaptation in gene regulatory circuits
ranked.summary: Stochastic models now quantify intrinsic limits on timing, metastability and noise-robust control in gene circuits.

ranked.headline: T2T-CHM13 cuts mapping bias while new haplotype and pangenome assemblies appear
ranked.summary: Reference choice and haplotype representation now directly shape alignment, variant interpretation, and trait-gene discovery in long-read genome data.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link vasculature, immune dynamics and drug delivery in tumour therapy
ranked.summary: Patient-specific and hybrid simulations now test therapy response mechanisms against tumour microenvironment constraints in silico.

ranked.headline: Explicit mechanistic models of promoter, stress-response and allosteric dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints fit explicit mechanistic state structure to measurements or bound it by physical limits, moving beyond empirical rate laws.

ranked.headline: Simulations localize residue-specific aggregation determinants in amyloidogenic proteins
ranked.summary: Recent all-atom and enhanced-sampling simulations resolve aggregation-prone contacts at residue level across Aβ, tau, α-synuclein and myocilin.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models link cell cooling, ciliary flow and corneal epithelial homeostasis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model formalize cell cooling, embryonic ciliary flow and corneal epithelial dynamics with experimentally tied outputs.

ranked.headline: Web-accessible tools now map brain coordinates, model neurons, and quantify morphology
ranked.summary: Interactive, browser-based, and packaged tools are moving specialized neuroscience analysis workflows into broadly accessible form.

ranked.headline: Reference-guided and parental-free methods resolve haplotypes in heterozygous genomes
ranked.summary: Heterozygous genomes sequenced with long reads require accurate haplotype phasing, and three recent tools target switch errors and reference bias.

ranked.headline: Structural variation and evolution reshape genome architecture and microRNA repertoires
ranked.summary: Near-complete genome assemblies and mammalian-scale comparisons now resolve structural variation and lineage-specific gene and miRNA evolution.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies of hickory, Aegilops and Vitis enable resistance mapping
ranked.summary: Three late-December 2025 preprints add chromosome-scale assemblies for hickory, Aegilops caudata and Vitis arizonica.

ranked.headline: Simulations assess how ligands and predicted structures engage RNA and DNA binding sites
ranked.summary: Explicit polarization and AlphaFold 3 benchmarking are sharpening computational views of how RNA, DNA, and ssDNA engage ligands and structure.

ranked.headline: Learned models extend Bacillus biosynthesis analysis from genomes to literature mining
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply genomic, structural, and LLM-based inference to microbial biosynthesis at pan-genome and literature scale.
